hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Mean is fair-shares; median is the middle. Pick the one the question actually asks for.
You need the two quartiles first. Each one is the median of one half of the sorted data.
The lower half $\{2, 4, 6, 8\}$ has median $Q_1 = 5$, and the upper half $\{10, 12, 14, 16\}$ has median $Q_3 = 13$. Subtract to get the IQR.
$13 - 5 = 8$, so the IQR of the set is $8$.

explanation: The $8$ ordered values split into the lower half $\{2, 4, 6, 8\}$ and the upper half $\{10, 12, 14, 16\}$.
$Q_1$ is the median of the lower half: $(4 + 6) \div 2 = 5$.
$Q_3$ is the median of the upper half: $(12 + 14) \div 2 = 13$.
The IQR is the difference of the quartiles: $13 - 5 = 8$.
